features.description: Chat agent in the IDE sidepane (Cmd+I) that edits files, runs terminal commands, and calls tools with no tool-call limit.
Agent-first interface unifying local, cloud, and remote-SSH agents across repos; runs beside or instead of the classic IDE.
Terminal agent with Agent, Plan, and Ask modes (Shift+Tab or --mode), headless output for scripts/CI, ACP, and a GitHub Actions integration.
Native iPhone/iPad app to start agents, follow them live, and review/merge their pull requests; shares a backend with cursor.com/agents and the desktop Agents Window.
Start and manage agents on the web at cursor.com/agents, with secrets, automations, and usage at cursor.com/dashboard.
A coordinator agent plans a feature or migration, delegates the code to worker agents, and brings the finished work back for review.
Delegated specialists with their own context window (built-in Explore and Browser subagents); usable in the editor, CLI, and Cloud Agents.
Shift+Tab mode that researches the codebase, asks clarifying questions, and produces an editable plan saved to your workspace.
Auto-review (sandboxed shell + cloud-side safety classifier), Allowlist, or Run Everything; sandboxed execution is a layer under the run mode.
Agents running in isolated cloud VMs with full dev environments: parallel execution, MCP, computer use, multi-repo changes, secrets, and private connectivity.
Run Cloud Agents on self-hosted machines and pools; choose your own runtime.
Cloud agents triggered on cron schedules or GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/Slack/webhook/Linear/Sentry/PagerDuty events, runnable as service accounts and managed via a Terraform provider.
GitHub PR review automation that flags bugs and security issues on every PR update; manually triggerable by commenting `cursor review`.
Cursor's early-beta git forge: create repos, push/pull, mirror from GitHub, browse code, open and merge pull requests, and share with your team.
Realtime voice calls with agents powered by Grok Voice in the Agents Window, IDE, web, and iOS; dictation is a separate feature; zero data retention with Privacy Mode.
Describe an app and Cursor builds it with database, auth, and deployment, then shares it via a link.
Cursor models (Grok 4.7/4.6/4.5 and Composer 2.5) included in weekly plan pools; third-party Claude/GPT/Gemini models at API list price on Premium and above.
Add your own OpenAI/Anthropic/Google/Azure/Bedrock API keys for unlimited use at your own cost (not available on the Plus tier).
Balances intelligence, cost, and reliability by routing each request across Cursor and third-party models.
Four instruction types: Project (.cursor/rules), User, Team (dashboard-managed), and AGENTS.md.
Portable SKILL.md packages; built-ins include /automate, /autopilot, /canvas, and /create-hook.
hooks.json scripts at project/user level (or via plugins) that observe, block, or modify stages of the agent loop over stdio JSON.
Install and manage MCP servers from Settings to connect external tools and data sources.
Ensures your code is never used for training; enabled by default for teams and enforceable organization-wide from the dashboard.

One subscription for Grok, Cursor, and X: Free, Plus $8/mo, Premium $30/mo, Super $100/mo, Ultra $200/mo, Teams $30-$200/seat, Enterprise custom; weekly shared usage pools; legacy Cursor plans keep working.
Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, Linear, Notion, GitHub/GitLab/Azure DevOps/Bitbucket, JetBrains, Xcode, and Tailscale integrations, plus TypeScript/Python Agent SDKs.
AI code completions accepted with the Tab key; free plans carry a limited Tab allowance that resets.
